about: The Mirror (REDESIGN.md Phase 16): the Yakṣa's questions put to the player, not the book, after the book has been read. Three a life, chosen by src/engine/mirror.js from what the life did (`when`); a rebellion in p.witness always takes the first. Unanswered, unrecorded, skippable. Register: if a line could be printed on a poster it is wrong. {age} is the age of the choice, {chose} and {took} the `mirror` phrases on the ego tests' options (content/situations.json), {who} a name from the cast. Drafts for Bhaskar's review (27 Oct).

intro.en: These are for you, not for the book. Nothing you think here is written down.
intro.hi: ये प्रश्न आपसे हैं, बही से नहीं। यहाँ आप जो सोचें, वह कहीं लिखा नहीं जाता।

q.en: At {age} you chose {chose}, and the life {took}. Which of you was it?
q.hi: {age} बरस पर आपने {chose} चुना था, और जीवन ने {took}। उन दोनों में आप कौन थे?

q.en: When you helped, did you want the other person to be free, or to need you?
q.hi: जब आपने मदद की, तो आप चाहते थे कि सामने वाला आज़ाद हो, या आप पर निर्भर रहे?

q.en: Which was harder to put down: the thing, or being the one who had it?
q.hi: छोड़ना किसे ज़्यादा मुश्किल था: उस चीज़ को, या उसे रखने वाला होने को?

q.en: Would you have made the same choice if nobody knew?
q.hi: अगर किसी को पता न चलता, तो क्या आप फिर भी वही चुनते?

q.en: When the door named the debt, had you forgotten it, or only stopped looking at it?
q.hi: जब द्वार ने क़र्ज़ का नाम लिया, तो क्या आप उसे भूल चुके थे, या बस उसकी ओर देखना छोड़ दिया था?

q.en: {who} died and nobody wrote. Were you waiting for {who} to?
q.hi: {who} चल बसे और किसी ने ख़बर नहीं भेजी। क्या आप {who} के लिखने की राह देख रहे थे?

q.en: When you sat still, what were you waiting for?
q.hi: जब आप स्थिर बैठे थे, तो किसकी प्रतीक्षा कर रहे थे?

q.en: Is there a year you would live again exactly as it was?
q.hi: क्या कोई ऐसा बरस है जिसे आप ठीक वैसा ही फिर से जीना चाहेंगे?
